mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or FEDFUNDS does not decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or returns fail to outperform a baseline model (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (business demand) and INDPRO (supply) indices signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise in the same month
failure_condition: The correlation between the two proxies does not exceed 0.5 in the 20-day window, or returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises while CPIAUCSL remains below 2.0%, it signals effective monetary tightening without inflationary pressures, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with controlled inflation
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the trigger occurring, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply index) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as stronger production capacity boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS exceeds 143,000 monthly, it signals a robust labor market, driving consumer spending and corporate profits, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not positive when PAYEMS crosses above 143,000, or returns fail to outperform a baseline model (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST (household demand) above 1060 units predicts stronger consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when HOUST crosses above 1060, or returns fail to outperform a baseline model (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 240), a rise in FEDFUNDS triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy tightening exacerbating inflation concerns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite the trigger occurring, or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 240 during the period.
